responseMessageContents.text: I see you have a Twilio account with messaging service `ivxholding.com` and a phone number. Let me connect Twilio to the backend so we can send the SMS. I'll need your Twilio credentials.

envs.name: IVX_TWILIO_ACCOUNT_SID
envs.description: Twilio Account SID (starts with AC...). Found in Twilio Console > Account Settings.

envs.name: IVX_TWILIO_AUTH_TOKEN
envs.description: Twilio Auth Token from Twilio Console > Account Settings (kept secret, not written to files).

envs.name: IVX_TWILIO_MESSAGING_SERVICE_SID
envs.description: Twilio Messaging Service SID (starts with MG...). From your Messaging Service ivxholding.com.

envs.name: IVX_TWILIO_FROM_PHONE
envs.description: Optional Twilio phone number (E.164) to send from. If using Messaging Service, you can leave this blank or use +15617822411.

input.reason: To connect Twilio Messaging Service and send the autonomous work report SMS to your phone (561-644-3503) immediately.
